assurance_scope.automated_scope: This unsigned AI-generated record validates a closed schema, the tested Git commit and uv.lock identity, exact recorded commands and zero caller-supplied exit codes, exact pytest collection-to-JUnit testcase equality, JUnit arithmetic, evidence byte identities, and strict visual-record bindings. It does not authenticate an operator or independently re-execute commands.
assurance_scope.package_runtime_scope: Post-build release-manifest and release_artifact gates, package inventory, and frozen-runtime facts are separately executed and bound by the final build workflow and RELEASE_MANIFEST.windows_build.
assurance_scope.transient_input_scope: The exact pytest collection inventory, JUnit XML, and reproduction outputs are transient retained-workspace inputs. Their identities and reconstructed facts are embedded; default verification is self-contained, while verify_inputs=True rechecks retained or freshly generated transient files. The deterministic collection and evidence reproductions are compared byte-for-byte. JUnit testcase IDs and outcomes are compared semantically because timing and host fields are not byte-reproducible.
